_notes: Read through slam/aruco_faces.py by final_demo_l3.py (final-demo branch) and, on the M3 branch, by operate.py (mapping) and auto_fruit_search.py (navigation).
Keep mapping and navigation on the same settings: a map built from block centres must be navigated with block centres.
MEASURE block_size (block edge) and marker_length (black square edge, null = 0.06). camera_offset (camera ahead of the wheel axle) is only used when there is no polynomial file.
polynomial_includes_face_offset: true if the tape-measured points in distortion_grid_data.csv were block centres, false if they were measured to the marker face.
heading_mapping is off until it has been tested together with the EKF changes; operate.py --face-heading turns it on for one run.

axes_deg: null = learn where the arena axes are in the map frame during the run (one sample per spot the robot stops at; heading from faces starts after axes_min_frames spots); a number fixes it. For runs on truemap.txt use auto_fruit_search.py --arena-axes 0 instead of editing this.
faces: false = the old behaviour everywhere (same as --no-faces on both programs).

one_marker_fix (step 3, opt-in: auto_fruit_search.py --one-marker-fix) takes the whole pose from one near marker seen at an angle; face_ids (step 4) remembers which printed face of each block points where and resets a heading that is off by more than 45 deg.

final_demo_l3.py overrides a few of these per run: polynomial ('' unless --dist-correction), axes_deg (--arena-axes, default 0: the robot starts square to a wall; --learn-axes = null), one_marker_fix, face_ids. It fuses the faces' heading in phase 0 too (before each marker update) and in the marker re-fit.

heading_confirm_*: a face heading that would move the heading by more than 3 sd (and 6+ deg) waits until ANOTHER block agrees, then goes in even past the gate (up to 40 deg). squareness_*: heading from faces switches itself off if more than half of 40+ frames disagree (blocks not square to the arena).
